tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow user to set time via HMI and update internal time counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the manual time entry path exists in the Clock settings)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Read the state of "Set Time Hours" and "Set Time Minutes" and record it
3. Set "Set Time Hours" to 10
4. Set "Set Time Minutes" to 30
5. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Time Hours" and "Set Time Minutes" are enabled for entry
3. "Set Time Hours" shows 10
4. "Set Time Minutes" shows 30
5. The HU display shows 10:30
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814069 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813919 為使用者可經 HU 設定選單設定時間；4813984 為該畫面之存在。UI 標籤取自 HMI Settings List 第 7 節 Clock（11 T4）。 001 之 Atl-Mid 物件 4814069 之 DR-11 佔位補於本條（該 leaf 三條 TC 中最直接引用 HU 設定選單者）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow user to set time via HMI and update internal time counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the internal counter follows manual entry while GPS sync is disabled)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Time Hours" to 23
3. Set "Set Time Minutes" to 59
4. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Time Hours" shows 23
3. "Set Time Minutes" shows 59
4. The HU display shows 23:59
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: 4813920 明訂 GPS 自動調整未設定時，內部計數依 Hour/Minute Setting 更新。23:59 為 24 小時制上界。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow user to set time via HMI and update internal time counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the manual entry items are greyed out while GPS sync is enabled)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Read the state of "Set Time Hours" and record it
3. Read the state of "Set Time Minutes" and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Time Hours" is greyed out
3. "Set Time Minutes" is greyed out
tcs.reasoning: 4813920 之條件為 GPS 自動調整未設定；其反面由 HMI Settings List 之註記 'Greys out with sync option selected' 佐證。 canon §8.7.4：外觀不蘊含不可操作性。來源（HMI Settings List 'Greys out with sync option selected'）本身只敘述外觀，4813920 亦未述及可操作性 —— 主張若及於可操作性即無來源（§8.4.2），故 test_item 下半與 ER 一同收斂為只主張外觀。

tcs.test_item:

(confirm local time is computed from GPS at key ON)

"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
GPS signal is available
Ignition is OFF
tcs.test_procedure:

2. Turn the ignition to ON
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The GPS position is set to the target time zone
2. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
3. The HU display shows the local time of the target time zone
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814088 標為 Atlantis Mid）
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814089 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813923 為 key ON 後以 GPS 計算時間（含時區與 DST）。其餘四物件標為 Atlantis Mid，依 R-TM63 寫 DR-11 佔位，TC 覆蓋不縮減。 canon §4.5：GPS 位置之設定為互動操作，屬 Procedure；input_test_data 不得重複同一資料，故為 NA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain internal time signal and update HU_Time.Info based on calculated values
(confirm the internal time signal carries the calculated counter value)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Time Hours" to 08
3. Set "Set Time Minutes" to 15
4. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Time Hours" shows 08
3. "Set Time Minutes" shows 15
4. $DateTmHour$ carries 0 in Hour1_TLM and 8 in Hour2_TLM
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4813921 設 HU_Time.Info 等於計數值，4813924 送出之。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall display time and date on HU and VES as per HMI requirements
(confirm the VES screens show the time regardless of the HU clock display status)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The VES screens are powered on
tcs.input_test_data: PENDING: DR-12 UI 標籤正式名稱（HU 時鐘顯示開關）
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it
2. Set the HU clock display status to OFF
3. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The VES screen shows a time value
2. The HU clock display status is OFF
3. The VES screen still shows the same time value
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.reasoning: 4813966 明訂 VES 顯示與 HU 時鐘顯示狀態無關。該開關之 UI 標籤未見於 HMI Settings List 第 7 節，依 13 §4 寫 DR-12 佔位。

tcs.expected_result: 1. The HU main screen shows the current day, month and year
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4814030 / 4814031 之日期顯示均以 'If applicable (Refer to HMI)' 為條件；本 TC 之前置條件即該條件成立之情形。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit time data periodically, on wakeup, and on user update via CAN messages
(confirm the time is sent on the dedicated telematics message)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
2. Read $DateTmMinute$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Minute1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Minute2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. $DateTmHour$ carries the current hour value
2. $DateTmMinute$ carries the current minute value
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4813926 送 HU_Time.Info via TELEMATICS_TIME_DATE；4813952 為 CAN 傳送至其他 ECU。MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409 / 410。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409 / 410（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:

The CAN bus is asleep

tcs.expected_result:

2. $DateTmHour$ carries the current hour value within one message cycle
3. $DateTmMinute$ carries the current minute value within one message cycle
tcs.reasoning: 4813954 逐字列出 $DateTmHour$ $DateTmMinute$ 為 CAN wakeup 後送出之訊號。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409 / 410（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall handle invalid/missing time signals using last valid values and fallback mechanisms
(confirm the last valid time is held for two minutes when an invalid signal is received)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The VES screens are powered on
The splash screen display time has ended
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it
2. PENDING: DR-20 注入無效 $DateTmHour$ 之操作方式
3. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it 1 minute later
tcs.expected_result:
1. The VES screen shows a valid time value
2. An invalid $DateTmHour$ is being received
3. The VES screen still shows the last valid time value
tcs.design_method: 基礎故障注入 (Fault Injection Lite)
tcs.reasoning: 4813967 明訂無效訊號後顯示最後有效值 2 分鐘。注入操作無來源，依 canon §8.4.3 寫佔位。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 canon §4.5 / R-TM66：本欄原載之資料為互動操作，屬 Procedure；input_test_data 為 NA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall handle invalid/missing time signals using last valid values and fallback mechanisms
(confirm dashes are shown after the two-minute hold expires)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The VES screens are powered on
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 注入無效 $DateTmHour$ 之操作方式
2. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it 2 minutes later
tcs.expected_result:
1. An invalid $DateTmHour$ is being received continuously
2. The VES screen shows dashes in place of the time value
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: 4813968 之 2 分鐘為狀態切換邊界，故取 BVA。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 canon §4.5 / R-TM66：本欄原載之資料為互動操作，屬 Procedure；input_test_data 為 NA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall handle invalid/missing time signals using last valid values and fallback mechanisms
(confirm the valid time replaces the dashes once valid data returns)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The VES screens are powered on
The VES screen is showing dashes
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 恢復有效 $DateTmHour$ 之操作方式
2. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. A valid $DateTmHour$ is being received
2. The VES screen shows the valid time value in place of the dashes
tcs.reasoning: 4813968 末句：有效資料回復後以有效值取代 dashes。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 canon §4.5 / R-TM66：本欄原載之資料為互動操作，屬 Procedure；input_test_data 為 NA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall determine and apply time zone automatically using GPS and retain last known value on restart
(confirm the last stored time zone is used when GPS time mode powers up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
A time zone has been applied
Ignition is OFF
tcs.input_test_data: PENDING: DR-10 使 GPS 訊號不可用之操作方式
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-10 Bench 使 GPS 訊號不可用之操作方式

tcs.reasoning: 4813993：GPS 時間模式開機時使用最後儲存之時區。
